headline: Young Dolph Throwback Shows Him Blessing A Cashier
body: A Young Dolph throwback clip is making the rounds again, showing the Memphis rapper trying to bless a cashier with a major tip. The moment fits Dolph's larger reputation with fans: he often used public moments to show love, give money back, and keep his independent success connected to everyday people.
